pattern: かと思ったら（かとおもったら）
purpose: Describe a striking change immediately after an observed event.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Just when I thought the rain had stopped, it started again.
The cat woke up, then immediately fell asleep again.
The light came on and then suddenly went out.
restrictions: Usually reports observed events, rather than the speaker’s deliberate sequence.
mistake: Use てから for an ordinary planned sequence.
